list_child.name: listDojoGradings
list_child.desc: This tool returns every belt grading currently on the dojo's schedule, spanning all ranks and outcomes. Use it whenever a complete view of upcoming and past gradings is needed to plan the next testing cycle.

decoys.name: listRegionalGradings
decoys.desc: This tool returns every belt grading currently on the regional association's calendar, spanning all member clubs and ranks. Use it whenever a complete view of inter-club gradings is needed to plan travel for students.

decoys.name: listSeminarGradings
decoys.desc: This tool returns every belt grading currently attached to a visiting master's seminar, spanning all ranks and outcomes. Use it whenever a complete view of seminar testing is needed to plan the next guest visit.

decoys.name: listFederationGradings
decoys.desc: This tool returns every belt grading currently lodged with the national federation, spanning all ranks and outcomes. Use it whenever a complete view of certified gradings is needed to check registration fees.

get_child.name: getGradingRecord
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single belt grading record by its id, including the student, target belt, and current outcome. Use it when one specific grading needs to be examined in detail.

decoys.name: getGradingSyllabus
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single belt grading's syllabus by its id, including the required kata, techniques, and sparring rounds. Use it when one specific grading's requirements need to be examined in detail.

decoys.name: getGradingScoresheet
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single belt grading's scoresheet by its id, including each examiner's marks and comments. Use it when one specific grading's scoring needs to be examined in detail.

decoys.name: getGradingPanel
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves a single belt grading's examiner panel by its id, including the senior instructors and their ranks. Use it when one specific grading's judges need to be examined in detail.

list_parent.name: listEnrolledStudents
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every student enrolled at the dojo, across all ranks and class times. Use it to see the full student roster before assigning or reviewing gradings.

decoys.name: listTrialStudents
decoys.desc: This tool lists every student on a trial membership at the dojo, across all ages and class times. Use it to see the full trial roster before following up on sign-ups.

decoys.name: listLapsedStudents
decoys.desc: This tool lists every student whose membership at the dojo has lapsed, across all ranks and class times. Use it to see the full lapsed roster before a re-enrollment drive.

decoys.name: listWaitlistStudents
decoys.desc: This tool lists every student on the waitlist for the dojo, across all ages and class times. Use it to see the full waitlist before opening new class places.

get_parent.name: getStudentProfile
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single student record by id, returning their contact details and grading history. Use it when details on one specific student are required.

decoys.name: getStudentDues
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single student's dues account by id, returning their payments and balance owed. Use it when billing on one specific student is required.

decoys.name: getStudentWaiver
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single student's signed waiver by id, returning their medical notes and emergency contact. Use it when paperwork on one specific student is required.

decoys.name: getStudentAttendance
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single student's attendance log by id, returning their classes attended and missed. Use it when attendance on one specific student is required.

delete_child.name: purgeGradingRecord
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a belt grading record from the dojo's system, and the action cannot be reversed once submitted. Use it when a grading was scheduled in error or has been fully superseded.

decoys.name: purgeGradingFootage
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the video footage of a belt grading from the dojo's system, and the action cannot be reversed once submitted. Use it when a recording was made in error or a family withdraws consent.

decoys.name: purgeGradingScores
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the examiner scoresheets of a belt grading from the dojo's system, and the action cannot be reversed once submitted. Use it when marks were entered in error and the panel must re-score.

decoys.name: voidGradingCertificate
decoys.desc: This tool permanently voids the rank certificate issued for a belt grading, and the action cannot be reversed once submitted. Use it when a certificate was printed in error or the rank is withdrawn.

set_enum.name: setGradingOutcome
set_enum.desc: This tool changes the outcome of a belt grading between pending, passed, and failed, recording the result of the test. Use it once a grading session has actually been run and a result needs to be logged.

decoys.name: setKataOutcome
decoys.desc: This tool changes the kata section outcome of a belt grading between pending, passed, and failed, recording the result of the forms. Use it once the kata portion has been run and a result needs to be logged.

decoys.name: setSparringOutcome
decoys.desc: This tool changes the sparring section outcome of a belt grading between pending, passed, and failed, recording the result of the bouts. Use it once the kumite portion has been run and a result needs to be logged.

decoys.name: setForecastOutcome
decoys.desc: This tool changes the instructor's forecast outcome for a belt grading between pending, passed, and failed, recording readiness ahead of the test. Use it once a pre-grading check has been run and a forecast needs to be logged.

set_bool.name: flagRegrade
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a belt grading as a re-grade, which affects how the result is recorded. Use it whenever a student is retesting for a belt they previously failed.

decoys.name: flagFasttrack
decoys.desc: This tool marks a belt grading as a double promotion, which lets the student skip a rank on a pass. Use it whenever an instructor recommends a student jump ahead a belt.

decoys.name: flagInjured
decoys.desc: This tool marks a belt grading as injury-modified, which changes the techniques the student is tested on. Use it whenever a student is testing with a declared injury.

decoys.name: flagHonorary
decoys.desc: This tool marks a belt grading as honorary, which affects how the rank is recorded with the federation. Use it whenever a rank is awarded for long service to the art.

set_ref.name: reassignStudent
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a belt grading from its currently listed student to a different one entirely. Use it when a grading was logged against the wrong student and needs correcting.

decoys.name: pairStudent
decoys.desc: This tool gives the sparring partner slot on a belt grading to a different student entirely. Use it when a candidate needs a better matched partner for the kumite section.
verbs: assign the sparring partner role on {obj} {to_name}

decoys.name: billStudent
decoys.desc: This tool charges the testing fee for a belt grading to a different student's account entirely. Use it when a sibling or family member is paying for the test.

decoys.name: shareStudent
decoys.desc: This tool shares the scoresheet from a belt grading with a different student for review. Use it when a training partner is helping the candidate prepare for a re-grade.

send.name: emailStudent
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a student, either about a specific grading or as a direct note. Use it to keep students informed of scheduling changes or results.

decoys.name: textStudent
decoys.desc: This tool sends a text message to a student, either about a specific grading or as a direct reminder. Use it to get urgent schedule changes to students quickly.
child_verbs: send a text to the student on {obj}

decoys.name: invoiceStudent
decoys.desc: This tool sends a fee invoice to a student, either for a specific grading or for monthly dues. Use it to bill students for testing fees or training.

decoys.name: inviteStudent
decoys.desc: This tool sends a seminar invitation to a student, either tied to a specific grading or as an open offer. Use it to fill places at guest instructor seminars.
child_verbs: invite the student behind {obj} to the seminar
send a seminar invite to the student on {obj}

create.name: createGrading
create.desc: This tool creates a new belt grading for a student, with an optional target belt and starting outcome. Use it when a student is entered into the next testing cycle.

decoys.name: createSeminar
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new seminar booking for a student, with an optional target belt and starting outcome. Use it when a student signs up for a guest instructor's session.

decoys.name: createTournament
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new tournament entry for a student, with an optional target belt and starting outcome. Use it when a student registers for an inter-club competition.

decoys.name: createPrivate
decoys.desc: This tool creates a new private lesson for a student, with an optional target belt and starting outcome. Use it when a student books one-to-one coaching before a test.

list_notes.name: listGradingNotes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the instructor notes attached to a single belt grading. Use it to read every remark the senior instructors have logged against that grading.

decoys.name: listGradingFeedback
decoys.desc: This tool returns the examiner feedback attached to a single belt grading. Use it to read every comment the panel has written on the candidate's performance.

decoys.name: listGradingIncidents
decoys.desc: This tool returns the injury reports attached to a single belt grading. Use it to read every incident the mat supervisors have logged against that grading.

decoys.name: listGradingAppeals
decoys.desc: This tool returns the result appeals attached to a single belt grading. Use it to read every challenge the student or family has lodged against that grading.

add_note.name: addGradingNote
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new instructor note to a belt grading, with an optional title. Use it to record a remark about the student's preparation or performance.

decoys.name: addGradingFeedback
decoys.desc: This tool attaches new examiner feedback to a belt grading, with an optional title. Use it to record the panel's comments on the candidate's technique.

decoys.name: addGradingIncident
decoys.desc: This tool files a new injury report on a belt grading, with an optional title. Use it to record an accident or first aid given on the mat.

decoys.name: addGradingAppeal
decoys.desc: This tool lodges a new result appeal on a belt grading, with an optional title. Use it to record a student's challenge to the panel's decision.

update_note.name: editGradingNote
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing instructor note on a belt grading. Use it to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: replyGradingNote
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing instructor note on a belt grading. Use it to answer a remark after another instructor has logged it.

decoys.name: endorseGradingNote
decoys.desc: This tool endorses an existing instructor note on a belt grading with the chief instructor's comment and an optional title. Use it to confirm a remark before results are published.

decoys.name: escalateGradingNote
decoys.desc: This tool escalates an existing instructor note on a belt grading to the association, with a comment and an optional title. Use it when a remark needs a ruling from above.

delete_note.name: deleteGradingNote
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes an instructor note from a belt grading, and the removal cannot be reversed. Use it to clear a remark logged against the wrong grading.

decoys.name: redactGradingNote
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of an instructor note on a belt grading, and the redaction cannot be reversed. Use it to strip personal details from a remark.

decoys.name: purgeGradingThread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes an instructor note and all its replies from a belt grading, and the removal cannot be reversed. Use it to clear a whole discussion from the record.

decoys.name: withdrawGradingAppeal
decoys.desc: This tool permanently withdraws a result appeal lodged on a belt grading, and the withdrawal cannot be reversed. Use it when a student drops their challenge to the panel.

set_image.name: setGradingImage
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on a belt grading record. It is typically a photo of the student taken on the day of the test.

decoys.name: setGradingCertificate
decoys.desc: This tool sets the certificate scan shown on a belt grading record. It is typically the signed rank certificate photographed after the test.

decoys.name: setGradingLineup
decoys.desc: This tool sets the group photo shown on a belt grading record. It is typically the line-up of candidates and examiners taken after the test.

decoys.name: setGradingPoster
decoys.desc: This tool sets the event poster shown on a belt grading record. It is typically the flyer advertising the testing day to families.

writer.name: writeText
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the gradings it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeReport
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short progress report from a brief, which states the feedback in the instructor's own words, and the gradings it should cover. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeAnnouncement
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short results announcement from a brief, which states the news in the requester's own words, and the gradings it should list. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeSpeech
decoys.desc: This tool writes a short presentation speech from a brief, which states the praise in the requester's own words, and the gradings it should honour. It returns the finished text.

image.name: renderImage
image.desc: This tool generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: findImage
decoys.desc: This tool finds a licensed image matching a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: renderVideo
decoys.desc: This tool generates a short video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the clip.

decoys.name: renderCertificate
decoys.desc: This tool generates a rank certificate from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the border.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: This tool searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use it to look up how the dojo's system works.

decoys.name: searchSyllabus
decoys.desc: This tool searches the grading syllabus and technique handbook with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use it to look up what a belt requires.

decoys.name: searchRules
decoys.desc: This tool searches the federation rules and competition bylaws with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use it to look up how a match is scored.

decoys.name: searchLineage
decoys.desc: This tool searches the lineage records and rank registry with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use it to look up who promoted whom.
